prompt_en:
A high-energy editorial photograph of an unmistakably adult bunny-girl performer sprawled across the center position of the rear bench seat in a moving compact van. She is visibly in her mid-twenties, with mature facial structure and adult proportions. She wears a sleek black satin bunny suit, opaque tights, a white collar, wrist cuffs, tall rabbit ears, and ankle boots. Her shoulders and hips sink against the rear backrest as she leans deeply backward, with the center three-point seat belt crossing her torso. Her thighs angle apart, both knees remain widely separated, and each booted foot stays planted on the van floor, creating a loose open-legged posture. She raises both hands beside her cheeks, each hand forming a clear V sign with separated index and middle fingers, creating a symmetrical double-peace pose.

Her expression is an exaggerated overwhelmed display: eyes visibly rolled upward and slightly crossed, tongue extended, cheeks flushed, and mouth open in theatrical happiness. Her asymmetric upward eye drift remains clear beneath a relaxed brow line. Shape the lips as a small symmetric rounded-open mouth. The centered tongue tip crosses the outer lip boundary. A subtle cheek blush and a slightly fatigued release blend into buoyant, unmistakable happiness. All facial components coexist simultaneously in the same expression, which reads as playful overwhelmed joy without contempt, ridicule, or mockery.

Photograph her from the front-center aisle looking back toward the rear bench in a wide seated full-body frame, with her face, both hands, reclined torso, separated knees, and both planted feet visible together. Keep both rear headrests, the full width of the bench, and the floor around her boots in frame so the central placement and sprawled leg geometry remain unmistakable. Through both side windows, streaked roadside lights and directional motion blur establish that the van is traveling at speed, while direct on-camera flash keeps the passenger, seat belt, upholstery, and costume sharply frozen. Use a close wide-angle documentary-fashion aesthetic, centered depth composition, crisp skin texture, glossy fabric highlights, and playful nightlife energy.
